title: Watching the AI Watchdogs: A Fairness and Robustness Analysis of AI Safety Moderation Classifiers

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Demographic Parity (DP) and Conditional Statistical Parity (CSP) on the Jigsaw-Gender dataset to compare moderation classification rates between comments mentioning male and female identities.

Calculating Demographic Parity (DP) and Conditional Statistical Parity (CSP) on the Jigsaw-Ethnicity dataset to assess differences in moderation outcomes across ethnic groups (e.g., Asian, Black, Latino, White).

Evaluating fairness by measuring Demographic Parity (DP) and Conditional Statistical Parity (CSP) on the Jigsaw-Disability dataset to compare the moderation rates of content mentioning physical, mental, and learning disabilities.

Measuring Demographic Parity (DP) and Conditional Statistical Parity (CSP) on the Jigsaw-Sexual_Orientation dataset to analyze safe/unsafe prediction disparities across different sexual orientations (e.g., heterosexual vs. homosexual/bisexual).

Calculating Demographic Parity (DP) and Conditional Statistical Parity (CSP) on a manually annotated Reddit-Ideology dataset to measure moderation bias between left-leaning and right-leaning comments.
